title: Towers
description: Tower types at tier 1, level 1, plus the rules for upgrading field towers during a PvE battle. Units follow common.schema.json.

role.description: One-line role for designers. Player-facing text lives in string tables.

cost_credits.description: Battle credits to build it as a field tower in PvE.

damage_x100.description: Damage per hit, times 100. 0 for support towers that don't attack.

shots_per_s_x100.description: Shots per second times 100: 2.5 shots per second is 250. 0 for support towers.

range_mt.description: Targeting range in thousandths of a tile.

splash_mt.description: Splash radius in thousandths of a tile. 0 means single target.

damage_type.description: Picks the shield multiplier in damage.json (step 5 of the damage pipeline). none is for support towers.

armor_pierce_bp.description: Share of the target's armor this tower ignores (step 6). The Railgun ignores 75%: 7500.

slow_bp.description: Speed reduction on hit. Slows from all sources stack up to status_effects.slow.max_total_bp.

type.description: Makes cloaked enemies in range targetable. They stay revealed for status_effects.reveal.linger_ms after leaving range.
Marks enemies in range so they take extra damage (status_effects.mark).

field_upgrades.description: Upgrading a field tower inside a PvE battle. Level 1 is the built tower.

max_level.description: Highest level a field tower can reach.

first_upgrade_cost_bp.description: Cost of the level 2 upgrade as a share of the tower's build cost.

cost_growth_bp.description: Each later upgrade costs the previous upgrade times this.

range_step_bp.description: Range added per level gained, as a share of base range (not compounding).

sell_refund_bp.description: Share of all credits spent on the tower (build plus upgrades) returned when it's sold.
